//ConnectionStrings: NO CONNECTION STRING IS COMMITTED. Supply ConnectionStrings:KellumsDatabase via environment variable (ConnectionStrings__KellumsDatabase), user secrets, or your host's secret store. Development falls back to LocalDB.

Business.//: FALLBACKS ONLY. The admin console at /admin/site-settings writes to the SiteSettings table, which takes precedence over everything here - that is where the business fills these in, with no rebuild. These values apply only until a row exists. Every one that is empty is HIDDEN on the public site rather than replaced with a placeholder.
Business.Tagline: Your home deserves a second chance.

AntiSpam.//IpHashSalt: MUST be overridden per environment via AntiSpam__IpHashSalt. The default in code is only adequate for local development.

MediaStorage.//RootPath: Where uploaded project photographs are written. Empty means <content root>/wwwroot/uploads. POINT THIS AT A PATH OUTSIDE THE DEPLOYMENT FOLDER if you want photographs to survive a redeploy - e.g. D:/home/kellums-media on Azure App Service, or /var/lib/kellums/media on Linux.
MediaStorage.//PublicPathPrefix: URL prefix the media root is served from. Must match nothing else in the app.
MediaStorage.//MaxUploadMegabytes: Per-file ceiling. The endpoint's own request limit sits slightly above this so an oversized file is refused with a clear message rather than a connection reset.

Notifications.//: NO DELIVERY PROVIDER IS CONFIGURED. New-lead notifications are written to the application log and the sender reports honestly that nothing was transmitted - it never claims a message was sent. Wiring a real provider means replacing INotificationSender and nothing else. Recipients listed here are used the moment one exists.
Notifications.//AdminBaseUrl: Absolute origin used to build the deep link into the console, e.g. https://www.example.com. Falls back to the request's own origin.

Seed.//: Seeding only inserts into empty tables and NEVER applies migrations. AdminPassword must come from user secrets or an environment variable (Seed__AdminPassword) - never from this file.
